findings.title: Python Pickle Deserialization RCE - Flag Extracted
findings.description: The Flask application deserializes the 'bookmarks' cookie using pickle.loads() without any validation. This allows arbitrary code execution by crafting a malicious pickle payload. The flag is stored as an environment variable FLAG in the application source code.
